mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, r.average_rating, sc.name AS sub_category_name, c.name AS category_name, s.keywords FROM spots s LEFT JOIN spot_photos sp ON s.id = sp.spot_id AND sp.display_order = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) r ON r.spot_id = s.id INNER JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.id = s.sub_category_id INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = sc.category_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM spots s
s.deleted_at IS NULL
AND ( s.spot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{hira}, '%') OR s.keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{hira}, '%')
OR s.spot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kana}, '%') OR s.keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kana}, '%')
)
SELECT count(*) FROM spots WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, r.average_rating, sc.name AS sub_category_name, c.name AS category_name, s.keywords FROM spots s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = s.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) sp ON true JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) r ON r.spot_id = s.id JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.id = s.sub_category_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = sc.category_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY average_rating DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
